name: guessit
description: Extract metadata from one movie or TV episode filename or release name

arguments.name: filename
arguments.desc: Filename, path or release name, e.g. The.Matrix.1999.1080p.BluRay.x264-GRP.mkv

arguments.name: options
arguments.desc: Optional guessit options: type (movie | episode), output (python | codes), expected_title, allowed_languages, ...

name: guessit_batch
description: Parse up to 100 filenames in one call with the same options

arguments.name: options
arguments.desc: Optional guessit options, as for guessit

name: guessit_properties
description: List every property guessit can return with its possible values
